PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Regulatory & Transaction Reporting professional with 3+ years of experience in investment banking, supporting end-to-end regulatory reporting across EMIR and MiFID and multiple asset classes including OTC derivatives, equity derivatives, equity swaps, options, FX, fixed income and equities. Experienced in transaction-data validation, reporting exceptions, client regulatory queries, escalations, issue resolution, regulatory controls, UAT and reporting process improvement. Strong exposure to client and stakeholder coordination and regulatory reporting submissions.

CORE SKILLS

Transaction / Regulatory Reporting Reporting Operations

Client & Stakeholder

Products

Testing & Change Tools

EMIR, MiFID, Regulatory Submissions, Reporting Controls

Transaction Data Validation, Exceptions, RCA, Issue Resolution, Escalations Client Regulatory Queries, Client Enquiries, Escalation Management, Stakeholder Coordination OTC Derivatives, Equity Derivatives, Equity Swaps, Options, FX, Fixed Income, Equities UAT, Validation, Regulatory Change, Process Improvement SQL, Power BI, Excel, MS Office, Regulatory Reporting Tools

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Team Lead – Data Management Bank of America | Sep 2026 – Present | Mumbai • Currently working as Team Lead in Data Management, with responsibility for team coordination and data-management

activities.

Regulatory & Transaction Reporting Analyst 3 (Senior Analyst) Morgan Stanley | Apr 2025 – Aug 2026 | Mumbai • Managed end-to-end regulatory and transaction reporting activities across OTC derivatives, equity derivatives, equity swaps,

options, FX, fixed income and equities.

Prepared and submitted accurate regulatory reports, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness in line with applicable regulatory requirements.

Worked across EMIR, MiFID and other global regulatory reporting frameworks, validating transaction data and reporting outputs against regulatory requirements.

Gathered, validated and analysed transaction-level data from multiple upstream sources to identify discrepancies, missing attributes and reporting exceptions.

Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and data-quality issues, performed root-cause analysis and coordinated corrective actions through final resolution.

Managed client regulatory queries and reporting enquiries, understanding client requirements, investigating issues and coordinating with internal teams to deliver timely resolution.

Handled client escalations related to regulatory reporting discrepancies, data issues and reporting status, ensuring end-to- end follow-up through closure.

Coordinated with clients, brokers, Compliance, Risk, Finance and Operations teams to resolve reporting issues within defined SLAs and regulatory timelines.

Supported clients in understanding reporting requirements, data issues and resolution procedures, providing clear explanations and status updates throughout the issue lifecycle.

Managed daily client enquiries and requests, prioritising issues based on regulatory impact and ensuring timely communication through resolution.

Supported regulatory reporting controls and validation processes to ensure reported transactions accurately reflected underlying trade data.

Krishna Nitin Nathwani

• Monitored regulatory changes and supported implementation of reporting-control enhancements to meet evolving

regulatory requirements.

Assisted with UAT and validation for reporting-process changes, including test execution, output validation, defect identification and resolution prior to production implementation.

Prepared management information packs and reporting dashboards covering reporting status, exceptions, remediation progress and key operational metrics for senior stakeholders.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to strengthen controls, improve reporting processes and enhance transaction- reporting quality and operational efficiency.

Compliance Analyst MUFG | Apr 2023 – Apr 2025 | Mumbai • Conducted audits of disclosure documents for accuracy and completeness and resolved discrepancies to ensure

compliance.

Executed client contracts across the APAC region, ensuring adherence to agency-agreement and compliance requirements. • Maintained investor-relations data, logged meetings and prepared briefing books supporting CRM activities. • Audited investor-relations data and generated share-registry reports for internal stakeholders. • Built long-term client relationships across multiple stock exchanges through disciplined compliance procedures.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

B.Com – University of Mumbai | 2022 • Certificate in Investment Banking Operations Professionals – Imarticus Learning | 2023

TECHNICAL SKILLS

SQL, Power BI, Data Visualization, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Regulatory Reporting Tools, Data Analysis, MS Office

Krishna Nitin Nathwani
